verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at https://filee.sh/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary. Many cited excerpts come from that file and cover formats, presets, and agent-usable CLI details: `filee convert --to/--preset`, `--json` output, and documented exit codes. An agent can be pointed at it to learn and drive the tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt, and evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or other agent-specific doc set.
